The skill lacks guidance that when multiple TOTAL-like lines exist, the final/rounded one near the bottom (and lines labelled 'Total Rounded', 'Rounded Total', 'Net Total', 'TOTAL:' in a larger-print style) should win over 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' / 'Total (Incl. of GST)' when a Rounding Adjustment line is present."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No fallback to reconstruct amounts when OCR drops the decimal point (e.g., '92 80', '9280', '2050'). Receipts with faded/low-contrast text require additional preprocessing: 3x upscaling + PSM 4, binarisation/thresholding, and inversion. Skill should enumerate a richer multi-pass recipe for receipts and recommend candidate voting across variants with tier-aware precedence rather than just picking first non-null."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Exclusions list in the skill is incomplete and not framed as extensible. Does not cover 'CASH RECEIVED', 'CASH PAYMENT', 'TOTAL EXCLUDING/EXCL.', 'TOTAL GST/TAX/SST', 'TOTAL ITEMS/QTY/QUANTITY/SAVINGS', 'ITEM COUNT', table column headers like 'DESCRIPTION', 'QTY PRICE AMOUNT', 'AMOUNT TX'. Skill should present exclusions as a maintained list with these variants and warn to filter column-header lines before fallback to next line."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date-extraction guidance assumes a single DATE_PATTERNS list with fixed ordering and no locale heuristic. For Malaysian/SE-Asian receipts (common in this dataset) the DD/MM/YYYY form is overwhelmingly dominant; skill should instruct to prefer DD/MM/YYYY interpretation on ambiguous separators and to validate month<=12 before swapping. Also must reject implausible dates (year outside 1990-2099, day>31) and prefer dates that appear near 'Date:' / 'Invoice' labels over timestamps elsewhere."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No cross-field sanity check: skill does not suggest validating extracted total against subtotal + rounding/tax lines when available, nor comparing against sum of line items. This would have caught 074 (702.00 vs itemised 102.00)."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"Minor: skill does not emphasise that for mixed string/null columns like total_amount, writing None via openpyxl is correct and pandas should use dtype=object to avoid NaN coercion. GST)' lines; (2) when GRAND TOTAL and TOTAL coexist, GRAND TOTAL wins only if no later rounded/net total exists; (3) within a tier, pick the LAST occurrence top-to-bottom before any 'summary_start' marker (payment/cash/change block)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand EXCLUSION_KEYWORDS enumeration and document them as extensible: include CASH TENDERED|RECEIVED|PAYMENT, CHANGE DUE, BALANCE, TOTAL GST|TAX|SST, TOTAL EXCLUDING|EXCL., TOTAL ITEMS|QTY|QUANTITY|SAVINGS, ITEM COUNT, DESCRIPTION, column-header combinations (QTY/PRICE/AMOUNT together on one line), POINTS AWARDED, TOTAL GROSS when a later TOTAL appears, SUB TOTAL / SUBTOTAL."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Document a richer multi-pass OCR recipe for receipts and a candidate-voting selector: run (a) default, (b) grayscale+autocontrast PSM 6, (c) 2x upscale+autocontrast PSM 6, (d) 3x upscale+autocontrast PSM 4, (e) inverted/thresholded PSM 6. Collect (tier_index, value) candidates from all variants; choose min tier_index first, then majority vote on value, then earliest-occurrence tiebreak. Explicitly warn that returning None (null) is preferred over returning a low-confidence wrong value."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'decimal reconstruction' heuristic: when a keyword-matched line (or its fallback next line) contains a number like 'DDDD' (3-5 digits) or 'DD DD' (space-separated 1-3 digit groups) and no 2-decimal number is otherwise present, split the last two digits as cents (e.g., '9280'→92.80, '92 80'→92.80). Mark such reconstructed values as lower-confidence and let voting override them if a cleaner variant exists."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Refine date extraction: (1) prefer DD/MM/YYYY on ambiguous DD/MM separators (document rationale: SE-Asian receipt locale commonly used in this corpus — but phrase generically as 'default to DD/MM/YYYY unless the first group >12 or an ISO YYYY-MM-DD form is present'); (2) prefer dates near a 'Date' label line over timestamps elsewhere; (3) validate year in [1990, 2099] and reject impossible dates; (4) when multiple candidate dates found, prefer the one in the top third of the receipt (header)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a sanity-check post-processing step: if a subtotal/sub-total line and a rounding-adjustment line are both detected, verify |picked_total − (subtotal + tax ± rounding)| < 0.05; otherwise fall back to the next candidate. Document this as optional but recommended for high-stakes extraction."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Formalise the output contract: total_amount must be either a Python None or a string with exactly two decimals; never NaN, never empty string, never a float. Reiterate that when writing to Excel, None maps to an empty cell, which is the required representation for extraction failure."},{"skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a short note under 'Working with pandas' that for columns intended to hold a string-or-None value (e.g., formatted monetary strings), use dtype=object and write None (not empty string) so downstream verifiers treating None and '' as different continue to work. Reference example: df['total_amount'] = df['total_amount'].astype('object') prior to to_excel."}],"confidence":0.78}
